defects.description: grafana publishes host port 9090 (`9090:3000`), colliding with prometheus's host port 9090 (`9090:9090`); two services cannot bind the same host port.
paraphrases: Host port 9090 is mapped by both prometheus (9090:9090) and grafana (9090:3000), which conflicts.
Port collision: grafana's `9090:3000` reuses host port 9090 already taken by prometheus.
Two services bind the same host port (9090), so the stack cannot start.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the published host ports of prometheus (line 8) and grafana (line 17) within the file.

defects.description: The prometheus config directory is mounted at `/config`, but the command loads the config from `/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml`, so the config file will not be found at the path the command expects.
paraphrases: The volume mounts the config at /config while the command points at /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml; the paths do not match.
prometheus.yml is mounted under /config but read from /etc/prometheus, so the container cannot find its config.
Mount target (/config) and the --config.file path (/etc/prometheus) are inconsistent.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the volume mount target (line 11) with the --config.file argument (line 6) in the same service; the mount should target /etc/prometheus.

defects.description: prometheus mounts the named volume `metrics_data`, which is not declared under the top-level `volumes` key (only `prom_data` exists there).
paraphrases: The named volume `metrics_data` is referenced but never defined at the top level (only `prom_data` is).
Dangling volume reference in the prometheus service.
defects.rationale: Findable by cross-checking the prometheus named-volume mount against the top-level volumes declaration (only prom_data is defined).
